faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about VIREL
faq.q1: How does VIREL analyze my profile?
faq.a1: Our AI analyzes your public Instagram profile, including bio, post frequency, engagement, hashtag usage and more to generate accurate insights.
faq.q2: Do I need to give my Instagram password?
faq.a2: No! VIREL only uses public data from your profile. We never ask for your Instagram password.
faq.q3: How quickly will I see results?
faq.a3: Users report increased engagement in the first 2 weeks when applying our recommendations. Consistent organic growth takes 30 to 90 days.
faq.a4: Yes! You can cancel your subscription at any time, without penalties or additional fees. Your account remains active until the end of the paid period.
faq.q5: Do plans have a trial period?
faq.a5: We offer 7 days free on all plans. You can try without needing to enter a credit card.
faq.a6: Yes! Our AI generates completely original captions based on your niche, tone of voice and post context.
faq.q7: Does it work for any niche?
faq.a7: Absolutely! VIREL was trained on data from creators of all niches: fashion, fitness, food, business, lifestyle and more.
faq.a8: Yes! Our support team speaks multiple languages and is available via chat and email during business hours.
